scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @campusflow/contracts && npm run build -w @campusflow/domain
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @campusflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @campusflow/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @campusflow/mobile
